proof_scope: Deterministic ops-discord entrypoint and env-backed webhook configuration guards. These cases do not send real webhook messages.

claims.proves: ops-discord can discover supported environment-backed webhook variables and render them without leaking token-bearing URLs.
claims.does_not_prove: live Discord delivery, Discord gateway monitoring, Slack delivery, memory persistence, or full skill readiness

cases.name: env-webhook-discovery-regression
command: repo=$(git -C .. rev-parse --show-toplevel) && cd "$repo" && uv run --project skills/ops-discord pytest skills/ops-discord/tests/test_env_webhooks.py -q && echo OPS_DISCORD_ENV_WEBHOOK_EVAL_OK

cases.name: env-webhook-secret-leak-negative
command: repo=$(git -C .. rev-parse --show-toplevel) && cd "$repo" && SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL='https://hooks.slack.com/services/TSECRET/BSECRET/CSECRET' uv run --project skills/ops-discord python skills/ops-discord/discord_ops.py webhook list

cases.name: bot-transport-resolves-when-no-webhook-exists
command: cd .. && env -u OPS_DISCORD_WEBHOOK_WATCHDOG_URL ./run.sh notify --webhook watchdog --content probe --dry-run --json 2>/dev/null | grep -q '"status": "NO_WEBHOOK"'; ./run.sh notify --discord-bot --channel-name horus --content probe --dry-run --json
cases.proves: NO_WEBHOOK for one name does not mean Discord is unconfigured: the bot transport still resolves a real guild+channel from DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN. Guards the 2026-09-03 incident where an agent asked the human to create a webhook while the bot path could already deliver.
cases.does_not_prove: A live post; that requires a non-dry-run notify with a message_id readback.
